authorities.coverage_semantics: Curated partial inventory of generator-facing public audio, MIDI, music, sequence, signal, and timebase contracts.
does_not_prove: An absent key is unsupported.
A declared design-time capability is built, activated, granted, or live in any running instance.

authorities.coverage_semantics: Static extraction of type IDs, factories, and baked parameter declarations from the covered Forge bake catalog headers.
does_not_prove: Pulp lacks an absent DSP primitive.
Construction-time or sample-rate-dependent values such as intrinsic latency.
A DSP-survey disposition, implementation claim, or release state.

authorities.coverage_semantics: Admission, claim, evidence, disposition, release, and cleanup protocol for the separately owned DSP survey workstream.
does_not_prove: The Pulp planning submodule pin contains the current DSP survey authority.
A claimed or surveyed capability is implemented, merged, released, or present in an installed SDK.

does_not_prove: Pulp lacks an absent lower-level primitive.

authorities.coverage_semantics: Discovery is broker-local; authoritative capability and lifecycle status is scoped to one explicitly selected exact live instance at query time.
does_not_prove: Static source or SDK presence means any instance is live.
An instance was discovered, launched, or selected; the caller must already hold its exact ID.
The newest or only instance may be selected implicitly.

authorities.coverage_semantics: Top-level C++ and Rust CLI dispatch is reconciled bidirectionally with the authored command-status manifest.
does_not_prove: A CLI command has an MCP equivalent.
A registered command is usable in the current build or installed configuration.
Offline command reachability implies a live operation or grant.

authorities.coverage_semantics: Exact tool descriptors advertised by the queried MCP server, including generated Timeline tools present in that build.
does_not_prove: An advertised tool has a same-named CLI command.
A tool invocation will succeed for a particular input, build option, environment, or live instance.
Offline MCP registration implies live-control authority.

authorities.coverage_semantics: In-progress ledger containing only reverified sequencer-related delivery rows, explicit surface dispositions, tombstones, and visible audit gaps.
does_not_prove: Historical census completeness while audit.status is in_progress.
A released row satisfies separately held product acceptance.
Static SDK or offline exposure implies live-product control.

authorities.coverage_semantics: Complete emitted schema manifest for the built-in Timeline registry in the queried binary.
does_not_prove: A schema type has an offline CLI verb, MCP tool, live-control operation, or released sequencer exposure.
